name: cm-maestro
description: Chartmetric internal MCP connectors. Registers Maestro (maestro.chartmetric.com) and its staging twin as remote MCP servers: read-only Postgres/ClickHouse/Snowflake, the data map, read-only Airflow, and the chartmetric-claude GitHub App PR-review tools. Each user authenticates with their own @chartmetric.com Google account.
